v1.0.0.description:
Première version stable de Grunnchipelago : l'apworld Archipelago pour **Grunn** et son mod client BepInEx.

## Installation

1. **Le mod** (tous les joueurs) : dézipper `Grunnchipelago-client-1.0.0.zip` dans `Grunn/BepInEx/plugins/`. BepInEx 5 (x64) doit être installé au préalable.
2. **L'apworld** (uniquement la personne qui génère la seed) : placer `grunn.apworld` dans `Archipelago/custom_worlds/`.
3. **Le YAML** : partir de `Grunn_template.yaml` (toutes les options y sont décrites).

Guides détaillés : [setup EN](https://github.com/Serial-Developer/Grunnchipelago/blob/master/apworld/grunn/docs/setup_en.md) · [setup FR](https://github.com/Serial-Developer/Grunnchipelago/blob/master/apworld/grunn/docs/setup_fr.md) · [options et objectifs](https://github.com/Serial-Developer/Grunnchipelago/blob/master/apworld/grunn/docs/en_Grunn.md)

## Ce que contient la randomisation

- Objets-clés, outils, clés, idoles, instruments et fragments d'âme mélangés dans le multimonde
- Checks additionnels : 32 polaroïds, 7 fantômes, 7 bonnes actions, 6 tâches d'entretien, les fins, et les 15 pièces avec `coinsanity`
- 3 objectifs : `good_ending`, `true_ending` (défaut), `all_endings`
- Bonus progressifs (vitesse, portée du sécateur, cadence) et 8 pièges
- DeathLink : les fins mortelles envoient la mort, en recevoir une remet le cycle à zéro
- Les objets reçus sont réinjectés automatiquement à chaque nouveau cycle
- Profil de sauvegarde dédié par seed : votre partie vanilla n'est pas touchée

## Corrections depuis la 0.1.0

- **L'apworld empaqueté ne se chargeait pas** : `data/ids.json` était lu avec `open()`, ce qui échoue dans une archive zip (`No functional world found to handle game Grunn`). Corrigé via `pkgutil`.
- **Manifest incomplet** : `compatible_version` manquait, ce qui aurait cassé le monde à partir d'Archipelago 0.7.0.
- Ajout du template YAML en téléchargement direct.

## Compatibilité

Archipelago 0.6.7 ou supérieur · Grunn (Steam, Windows) · BepInEx 5 x64

v1.0.1.description:
Bug-fix patch. **No in-game behaviour changes**: existing seeds and runs stay compatible,
and the 1.0.0 mod still works with a 1.0.1 seed (and the other way round). Updating is
still recommended so everyone runs the same version.

## Installation

1. **The mod** (every player): unzip `Grunnchipelago-client-1.0.1.zip` into `Grunn/BepInEx/plugins/`. BepInEx 5 (x64) must already be installed.
2. **The apworld** (only whoever generates the seed): drop `grunn.apworld` into `Archipelago/custom_worlds/`.
3. **The YAML**: start from `Grunn_template.yaml` (every option is documented in it).

Detailed guides: [setup EN](https://github.com/Serial-Developer/Grunnchipelago/blob/master/apworld/grunn/docs/setup_en.md) · [setup FR](https://github.com/Serial-Developer/Grunnchipelago/blob/master/apworld/grunn/docs/setup_fr.md) · [goals and options](https://github.com/Serial-Developer/Grunnchipelago/blob/master/apworld/grunn/docs/en_Grunn.md)

## What changed

- **Regression tests** for the `keep_vanilla_shears` + `lock_player_hut` combination,
  following a playtest report: the polaroids the game only reveals once you have been
  inside the player hut (magpie nest, tall man at the window) do require the hut key,
  and the location holding that key is always reachable without it.
- **Design documentation fixed**: it still referred to `keep_shears`, an option name that
  no longer exists. Worth knowing for your own YAMLs: an unknown option name **does not
  fail generation**: Archipelago prints a single warning line
  (`... is not a valid option name for Grunn`) and then generates with the default value.
  When in doubt, always start from `Grunn_template.yaml`.

## About the playtest report

The reported behaviour (the hut key appearing reachable too early) **could not be
reproduced**: 30 seeds generated with those options, checked with strict sphere-based
accessibility, no anomaly; and the game's own conditions confirm the rule in place (the
nest polaroid is revealed by having entered the hut, nothing else). The most likely
explanation remains a version mismatch between the apworld that generated the seed and the
one the tracker loads. Hence this release, which puts everyone on the same version. If it
happens again, please attach the YAML, the spoiler log and the version in use.

## Compatibility

Archipelago 0.6.7 or later · Grunn (Steam, Windows) · BepInEx 5 x64

v1.0.1.title: Grunnchipelago 1.0.1

v1.1.0.description:
New option to hide what every check contains, plus a batch of item classification fixes.

## Installation

1. **The mod** (every player): unzip `Grunnchipelago-client-1.1.0.zip` into `Grunn/BepInEx/plugins/`. BepInEx 5 (x64) must already be installed.
2. **The apworld** (only whoever generates the seed): drop `grunn.apworld` into `Archipelago/custom_worlds/`.
3. **The YAML**: start from `Grunn_template.yaml` (every option is documented in it).

Detailed guides: [setup EN](https://github.com/Serial-Developer/Grunnchipelago/blob/master/apworld/grunn/docs/setup_en.md) · [setup FR](https://github.com/Serial-Developer/Grunnchipelago/blob/master/apworld/grunn/docs/setup_fr.md) · [goals and options](https://github.com/Serial-Developer/Grunnchipelago/blob/master/apworld/grunn/docs/en_Grunn.md)

## New option: `mask_items`

Off by default. Turn it on and no location shows what it holds any more. Every spot wears an Archipelago model coloured by the class of its content: progression, useful or filler. Grunn's own items are masked too, which is the whole point of the mode. You always know how valuable a check is, never what it is.

Traps borrow one of the three models. The choice is fixed per location and per seed, so relaunching the game never gives them away.

It is purely cosmetic. Item placement, logic and generation are identical with the option on or off, and the pickup message still names what you actually got.

## Item classification

- **Popcorn** is now filler. It does nothing in game and no access rule uses it. Corn and Butter stay progression since they gate its cooking.
- **Garden Key** and **Strange Key** are now progression. Both open a vanilla door, even though the logic knows a way around each of them.
- **Abandoned Key** is only added to the pool when `lock_player_hut` is on, since that option is the only thing that gives the key a use. With the option off it no longer takes a slot.

## Fixes

- The burnt bramble between the park and the road now stays open with `persistent_shortcuts`, like the other comfort shortcuts.
- `archipelago.json` no longer hardcodes the packaging fields `version` and `compatible_version`. They are injected when the `.apworld` is built, read from the Archipelago version it is built against. Archipelago's own test suite rejects a world folder that declares them, and a hardcoded value would go stale the day the packaging scheme changes.

## Compatibility

Update both parts. The classification changes affect generation, so a seed made with 1.1.0 differs from one made with 1.0.1, and `mask_items` needs the 1.1.0 client to be read at all.

Archipelago 0.6.7 or later · Grunn (Steam, Windows) · BepInEx 5 x64

v1.1.0.title: Grunnchipelago 1.1.0

v1.1.1.description:
Logic fixes, all reported or found while chasing a player report. If you're on 1.1.0, grab this one: two of the four ways out of the garden didn't work in logic.

## Fixed

**The fisherman's cabin was reachable from the back yard.** `Ending: Dog` showed up in logic with nothing but the Bridge Key, which is what got reported. The dog, the fisherman, the worm and the bone polaroid all sit under `BehindHouse` in the game's own scene hierarchy, but they're actually out in the Windy Path, so I had a free connection there that shouldn't exist. Leaving the yard means cutting the hedge, same as always. This also pulled `Obtain Worm`, `Obtain AbandonedKey`, the bone polaroid and the ferry back to where they belong.

**Two passages only worked one way.** Removing that shortcut exposed them: the repaired church door (Pillar Space) and the burnt bramble into the park both let you walk back out in game, but the logic only knew how to go in. So going Garden Key -> church -> Doorknob -> outside, or Garden Key -> church -> Paddle -> park -> Lighter -> outside, did nothing as far as the generator was concerned. Both are proper two-way passages now.

**The park's 20% bar was too strict.** Getting to the hay bale (and the merchant behind it) asked for mowing *and* watering. There's a load of litter in the park you pick up bare-handed, so any single tool is enough to clear it (the Coin works too, through the rain). Same fix the garden's 30% got a while back.

All four routes out of the garden are covered again: shears or magic sword, plank or old plank, Garden Key + Doorknob, Garden Key + Paddle + Lighter. The Bridge Key on its own gets you nowhere, as intended.

## Install

Same as before. Unzip `Grunnchipelago-client-1.1.1.zip` into `Grunn/BepInEx/plugins/`, drop `grunn.apworld` in `Archipelago/custom_worlds/` if you're the one generating.

Existing 1.1.0 seeds still work, but they were rolled with the old logic, regenerate if you want the fixes.

Setup guides (EN/FR) and the full option list are in the repo.
v1.1.1.title: Grunnchipelago 1.1.1

v1.1.2.description:
One more logic fix, in the same vein as 1.1.1. Nothing was unbeatable, but the generator was being stricter than the game.

## Fixed

**The magic pond was locked behind Sunday night.** . So `Obtain GoldFishAlive` asked for the last day of the week, and for the Abandoned Key on top of it if you play with `lock_player_hut`.

The correct path is fixed : hand the Worm to the fisherman on his bench in the Windy Path, turn around, walk a few steps, and he's gone. The way to the red chapel opens right next to him, and the pond is part of that same area. He only shows up during the day on Saturday or Sunday, which costs nothing in logic since sleeping moves the clock along anyway.

So the pond now has two ways in: the Worm route.

## Install

Unzip `Grunnchipelago-client-1.1.2.zip` into `Grunn/BepInEx/plugins/`, and drop `grunn.apworld` in `Archipelago/custom_worlds/` if you're generating.

Seeds rolled on 1.1.1 still work, they were just built with tighter logic than they needed. Regenerate if you want the fix.

Setup guides (EN/FR) and the full option list are in the repo.
v1.1.2.title: Grunnchipelago 1.1.2

v1.1.3.description:
Two logic fixes. The second one could actually make a seed unbeatable, so this one is worth taking.

## Fixed

**The Sunday night hallway did not open the magic pond.** The logic thought it did, going by a portal in the scene data that the player never actually walks through. The hallway has nothing to do with the red chapel: without the Strange Key it dead ends, and with it the door at the far end opens onto the Orb Room, which spits you back out in the garden. The pond has one way in and always did, which is handing the Worm to the fisherman.

**The Orb Room polaroids did not ask for the Strange Key.** `Polaroid: Crypt` and `Polaroid: GnomeIdol` only appear in the start garden after you have talked to the Orb, and the Orb is behind the locked door at the end of the hallway. The logic only asked you to reach the hallway, so a seed could have expected you to grab them without ever being able to open that door.

## Install

Unzip `Grunnchipelago-client-1.1.3.zip` into `Grunn/BepInEx/plugins/`, and drop `grunn.apworld` in `Archipelago/custom_worlds/` if you're generating.

If you have a 1.1.2 seed in progress with polaroid checks on, regenerating is the safe call.

Setup guides (EN/FR) and the full option list are in the repo.
